whole_span_scope: Includes cold GUI initialization, six stores, anonymous account/catalog seeding, 14-step replay, then idle; not a steady-idle CPU measurement
tail_selection: Samples at or after (last sample elapsed minus 30 seconds), no interpolation
log_clock_scope: 1-second driver file-size samples use a monotonic origin immediately after launching the observer; observer process-sample elapsed uses its own earlier monotonic origin. Exact offset was not recorded. These are coarse visibility upper bounds, not instrument or GUI event timestamps.
tail_phase: EOF prefix is already visible in the log before the last-30-second selection; selected tail is post-replay idle with the initialized six stores retained.
replay_schedule: 14 events at nominal 250ms per step (~3.5s) starts after six stores and session are ready; it is not the first 3.5s after process startup.
limits: This reuses one run and is not a matched-load before/after comparison. No claim about the source of 41 threads, no UI action latency, RK budget, real instrument or long stability qualification.
